content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for NIMHANS Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIMHANS recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is through a walk-in interview, and the walk-in date is 26 September 2026. Candidates should report on this date with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q2. What are the eligibility criteria for the Yoga Therapist post?
faq.answer: For the Yoga Therapist position, candidates must have an MSc in Yoga and proficiency in English and Tamil languages.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: To be eligible for the Junior Research Fellow role, candidates need an M. Phil in Psychiatric Social Work/ Psychology or an MSc in Psychology/Counselling Psychology with at least one year of experience in mental health. Proficiency in English and Tamil is also required.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for Yoga Therapist and Junior Research Fellow posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced by NIMHANS. One post is for Yoga Therapist, and two posts are for Junior Research Fellow.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for these NIMHANS positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the advertised posts is 40 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Yoga Therapist and Junior Research Fellow posts?
faq.answer: The salary for the Yoga Therapist post is Rs. 30,000 per month, and for the Junior Research Fellow post, it is Rs. 50,000 per month.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for NIMHANS recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these NIMHANS jobs?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Walk-in-cum-Written Test followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to take place?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at NIMHANS, Bengaluru, Karnataka, with the pincode 560029.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should candidates bring for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs. This includes ID proof, educational certificates, and experience certificates if applicable.
